review.counterexample: Frozen E.Bridge is a function; raw Object check only accepts table/userdata, so normal purchase always rejects.

generic_lessons: Complete SSE and valid outer JSON do not imply supported source syntax. Lua5.1 continue is a compile failure, not a transport failure.
A function-valued dependency must be checked as a function. Applying a table/userdata helper to E.Bridge rejects every normal positive path.
A new purchase receipt needs to be included in busy-phase reconciliation. Storage alone cannot release the real UI consumer.
Do not permanently mark a held actor evaluated for the turn; receipt release must restore its normal scheduling in the same turn.
Fixture steering must change the actual getter or producer. An unused leader field does not test ownership changes.
Keep actual SDK writes distinct from supplied command adapters. Preserve private diagnostic rejection rules and capture functions into locals for identity comparisons.
The actual consumer must persist permission before one native request and hold unknown results. Void/false/throw cannot cancel or authorize retries.
Cold UI metadata reconstruction in isolated bindings is not real game save/load, Native purchase or religious combat UI permission proof.
